title: •Dash Rendar
caption: •Dash Rendar (V)
game_text: {pilot:3}. While piloting alone (or at same location as opponent’s AT-AT or Imperial), draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise and opponent draws no more than one battle destiny here. Dash is a matching pilot for any unique (•) Rogue speeder.
lore: Emperor banished Rendar family from Coruscant. Became *gambler* and *smuggler*. Brought down AT-AT at the Battle of Hoth. Works for Rebel Alliance from time to time.

notes: Unique. Stats POWER 3 / ABILITY 3 / FORCE-ATTUNED (label only); deploy 3 / forfeit 5. Yellow pilot-power icon followed by '3.' at the start → {pilot:3} (stub expands 'Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots'). Slip prints '(•)' where the stub has '(*)'. Icon column top to bottom: pilot, warrior. Alien (Reflections II frame, black alien disc). Lore corrected from scan: 'gambler' and 'smuggler' are bold; wiki plain. Base scan only 354×492. Copyright read off the scan: '© 2000 LUCASFILM LTD. & TM. TM, ® & © 2000 DECIPHER INC.'.
